description: This PHP source file defines the DatabaseConfigAPI class, which extends an abstract REST controller to handle API requests related to database configuration in an installer context. It includes methods for handling POST requests to set up new or existing databases and GET requests to retrieve current database configuration details.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: Handles database configuration API requests during installation, including setting up new or existing databases and retrieving current database configuration state.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests for configuring database connection details, either for new or existing databases, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve current database connection configuration details from the internal state container.
